en: Sepia-toned vintage street view showing a wide, mostly empty road lined with multi-story residential buildings on both sides. Young leafless trees and utility poles run along the sidewalks. A person in early 20th‑century clothing stands near a fence in the right foreground. At the top left of the image, printed text reads "Bautzen" and at the top center/right "Sedanstraße," indicating the name of the town and street.
